movingFrameControl.cutoffScope: This is the UNCUT homogeneous coefficient. Original psi is flat at v=0. Extending noncancellation to its positive middle support requires analytic continuation of the uncut coefficient and parameter response.
movingFrameControl.analyticPremise: Fixed-slow original ntheta=p/R is nonzero, keeping normal denominators positive; original matrix coefficients and their ODE parameter responses are analytic in pulse v.
movingFrameControl.scalarHWeight: A pulse-independent positive weight cannot annul the entire uncut FR response: value!=0 and raw_FR=0 at v0 force weight_FR=0 if the response vanished identically, while mixed_FR_v!=0 then contradicts it.
movingFrameControl.claim: No universal moving-frame/constraint/normal quotient identity removes this additional layer; this is not a numerical counterexample to the fixed actual source.
